run_GTestJsonOutputUnitTest: run the GTestJsonOutputUnitTest class to verify Google Test JSON output functionality
test_non_empty_json_output: test that a Google Test binary produces correct non-empty JSON output with all test results
test_empty_json_output: test that a Google Test binary with no tests produces an empty JSON output
test_timestamp_value: test that the timestamp attribute in JSON output is a valid ISO 8601 datetime string
test_filtered_json_output: test that applying a gtest_filter flag produces JSON output with only matching tests
